name: Guo et al. 2006, 3-phase SMC TFM, 640 W at 1800 rpm (review Table 2, row 5)
source: Y. G. Guo, J. G. Zhu, P. A. Watterson, W. Wu, "Development of a PM transverse flux motor with soft magnetic composite core", IEEE Trans. Energy Conversion 21(2), 426-434, 2006. Open copy: https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/bitstream/10453/5857/3/2006004024.pdf. Design paper: Guo et al., ICEMS 2003.

notes.stator: Table I: stator outer radius 40, coil window 15 (axial) x 20.5 (radial), 10 teeth per side per phase (60 in total), effective axial length 93 for 3 stacks -> 31 per stack, legs (31 - 15) / 2 = 8 (ICEMS 2003: narrowest tooth 8 mm), yoke 10 (ICEMS 2003) -> bore radius 9.5 = shaft radius. Side discs with teeth (paper: 'stator side discs', 'stator teeth', Fig. 1b, Fig. 3): toothed ring. Teeth aligned on both sides (Fig. 2: the two magnet arrays of a phase have opposite polarity at the same angle).
notes.assumed: ring_tooth_height 10 mm (not published; variants 6 and 14 mm), tooth arc 12 deg = magnet arc (tooth_span 0.667; not published), straight-cut teeth (the real teeth taper, Fig. 3), coil 13 x 18.5 mm in the window, magnet remanence 1.10 T (N30M data sheet range 1.08-1.13 T), SMC B-H curve Froehlich mu_r 500 / Js 1.9 T (B = 1.47 T at 10 kA/m, close to Somaloy 500), mild-steel rotor mu_r 2000 / Js 2.0 T (paper: mu_r about 5000), SOMALOY 500 alternating-loss fit of Guo, Zhu, Zhong, Wu, IEEE TMAG 39(5), 2003 (C_ha 0.1402, h 1.548, C_ea 1.233e-5, C_aa 3.645e-4, W/kg), applied to the peak flux density (no rotational loss); SMC density 7300 kg/m3.
notes.rotor: Table I: outer rotor, rotor inner radius 41 (air gap 1), outer radius 47, magnets OD 88 x ID 82 x 9 mm, arc 12 deg (pole pitch 18 deg -> arc ratio 0.667), radial magnetisation, two arrays per phase, assumed centred on the teeth (centres at +-11.5 mm): inner edges at +-7 mm -> row gap 14 mm, rotor stack per phase 32 mm.
notes.not_modelled: silicon-steel sheets between the stacks and coupling between the phases (measured L 6.33 / 6.94 mH), mild-steel shaft, six-step current of the real drive (here sinusoidal with the same rms fundamental), eddy currents in the rotor yoke.
notes.losses: T31: SOMALOY 500 alternating and rotational loss (Guo, Zhu, Zhong, Wu, IEEE TMAG 39(5), 2003); mild-steel rotor yoke conductivity 1.12e7 S/m (stated in the claw-pole papers), thin-plate eddy formula with the skin-effect factor of a plate at the incremental permeability of the B-H model (no fitted correction; the authors' factor k_e is not published); NdFeB conductivity 6.7e5 S/m (assumed).
